card.name: Dunavsko Horo
card.tagline: Northern Bulgaria's beloved New Year's Danube line dance.
card.profile: A traditional chain/line dance from the Severnyashka (Northern/Danube) region, based on a simple 6-bar pravo horo in 2/4 marching time, with many variations and quick forward/back arm movements (basic pattern: five steps forward, three back). Set to the famous brass-band composition by Diko Iliev, written 18 April 1937 while he worked in the orchestra of the 36th Infantry Kozloduy Regiment at Oryahovo (Fort Collins Folk Dance; Radio Bulgaria/BNR).
card.insight: Per Radio Bulgaria/BNR (quoting Taratanci's Iva Todorova), it is 'the invisible spiritual thread that connects millions of Bulgarians' and, alongside Pravo Horo, a well-known chain-dance anthem; it is played every New Year's Eve after the national anthem (Fort Collins Folk Dance; BNR).
card.image_significance: Bulgaria's New Year's Eve dance. A representative image shows folk dress and patterned partner or group figures — Danube/Severnyashka, Bulgaria.
